faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Can't find yours? Ask in the chat itself

items.a: Tap "Try {days} days free" and say hi on WhatsApp. It works on your phone or your computer.

items.q: How does the free trial work?
items.a: You get {days} days with everything in Premium, counted from your first message, no card needed. Premium Pro has no trial: it has a 7 day guarantee.

items.q: What happens when the trial ends?
items.a: The diary stops logging until you subscribe. Everything you logged stays saved and comes back in full when you subscribe.

items.q: How do I pay and cancel?
items.a: Right in the chat: reply "subscribe" and choose the plan. Monthly is by Pix or card, and by card it renews on its own every month until you cancel. Yearly is by card, in up to 12 interest-free installments. Cancel whenever you like; your access lasts until the end of the period you paid for. Pix is for monthly only. Premium Pro is a 12-month program, by card only, upfront or in up to 12 interest-free installments, with no renewal. Buying Premium Pro cancels your monthly card subscription, and the Premium days you already paid for are discounted from the price.

items.q: What if I change my mind?
items.a: Within 7 days of paying, for Premium or Premium Pro, ask for a refund in the chat and it goes through on its own, in full.

items.q: Who looks after my plan on Premium Pro?
items.a: The assistant. You do a full assessment, and it builds your diet and training from it, with evidence-based methods and reference content. Through the check-ins and the monthly reassessment, it adjusts the plan to your progress, and your questions go to our team, who answer in the chat within 24 hours.

No. The assistant is artificial intelligence: it logs, adds up, informs and suggests from reference content, and shows the source when you ask. On Premium, it doesn't prescribe diets or workouts. On Premium Pro, it builds your diet and training from your assessment, and your questions go to our team.
It's used only for your diary and handled under Brazil's data protection law (LGPD).
